cues.text: Well, well, well, well, well!

cues.translation: 아 그래 맞아 그 얘기 수도 없이 들었어

cues.text: Gee, it's swell to finally meet her other friends

cues.text: I'm the loser of the game you didn't know you were playing!

cues.text: Let's play another game, this time I get to win

cues.text: Lives on the line

cues.text: Winner takes all
